derived_files.derived: Canonical JSON rule: sorted keys, ensure_ascii=False, separators (",", ":"), allow_nan=False, trailing newline, UTF-8.
Same canonical JSON rule, reimplemented in Rust to match byte-for-byte.

Append-only SQLite/WAL journal, SHA-256 prior->record digest chaining from a GENESIS anchor, committed head digest plus record count for truncation detection, wall-clock fields excluded from digested payloads.
derived_files.divergence: B1 uses one global chain over a single monotonic seq; upstream chains per (run_id, attempt, seq).

derived_files.derived: Same root journal design in Rust.
derived_files.divergence: B1 uses one global chain over a single monotonic seq; upstream chains per (run_id, attempt, seq).

derived_files.derived: Effect-time staleness detection by digest comparison. Upstream raises 'run context changed; re-plan before effects' at store.py:737-740 when a project context digest no longer matches.
derived_files.divergence: B1 moves the digest inside the authority envelope so the envelope is self-describing, and adds a plan digest alongside the state digest. B1 also bounds authority by an explicit scope whose matcher does not let a wildcard cross a directory boundary.

derived_files.derived: Approval to one-time permit to fence to permit-digest-bound transition proof. Upstream's SovereignWorkRuntime validates and consumes an approval in one transaction (store.py:766-772, a conditional UPDATE plus a changes() check), issues a per-domain monotonic fence, allows one active permit per target, and binds a transition proof to a permit digest with capability, target and epochs checked.
derived_files.divergence: B1 revalidates the authority a second time at consume time, not only at claim time, so an authorization that goes stale while the executor is working is refused before the effect is recorded. B1 also flags an effect identity for reconciliation on an UNKNOWN receipt and refuses any further permit for it until real state has been read back with cited evidence.

derived_files.derived: Manifest-driven fourteen-language conformance verification, unique responsibility and unique observable-contribution checks, exact expected-output matching, missing toolchain reported as UNKNOWN rather than promoted from source-file existence.
derived_files.divergence: B1 executes each manifest's declared build_command/run_command templates rather than hardcoded per-language commands, removes the build_command non-empty exemption, and targets dotnet instead of legacy csc/mono.

derived_files.derived: Observation that WireApi has exactly one variant (Responses), that wire_api="chat" is a hard deserialization error, and that the ollama-chat provider was removed.
Observation that the embeddings endpoint is hardcoded to api.openai.com, making the scanner non-local.
